answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The copper of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The beacon holds work receipts rather than names, so the relic of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool.
